title: Draft notice after leaving the church

tellings.quote: feel that secure. So I I left. Right. As soon as I left the church, I got a notice from selective service that I was being drafted.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author described on the show as a CIA historian, says that in the late 1960s in New York he got a draft notice from the Selective Service as soon as he left the church. He tells Michels he left because he didn't 'feel that secure' there, and the notice arrived right after.
